title: Find-a-Line
description: The application: queue, worker, searches, quick lane, accounts, use and storage (docs/monitoring.md, rows F1-F10, F14-F16).

list.name: Deployments
list.expr: count by (version) (findaline_build_info) unless count by (version) (findaline_build_info offset 5m)

panels.title: At a glance (F1-F10): red needs attention
Worker (F1)
panels.description: Workers with a live lease (renewed every 5 s, valid 30 s). Alert: none for 2 min.

panels.title: Queue (F2)
panels.description: Searches waiting or running against queue_max (new searches are refused at 100 %). Alert above 80 %.

panels.title: Waiting (F2)
panels.description: Age of the oldest queued or downloaded search not yet running. Alert above 30 min.

panels.title: Running (F2)
panels.description: Searches in each phase now (the worker's slots: the chart below).

panels.title: Internal (F3)
panels.description: In the last 24 hours: searches failed by an unexpected exception ("internal error, ref ..." for the user). Alert on any.

targets.expr: (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{error="internal"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{error="internal"} offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)

panels.title: Failed (F3)
panels.description: Share of the searches finished in the last hour that failed. Alert above 30 % (at least 3 finished).

targets.expr: ((sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{status="failed"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{status="failed"} offset 1h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 1h) * 0)) / ((sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total offset 1h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 1h) * 0)) * 100

panels.title: Quick (F5)
panels.description: Age of the oldest waiting estimate, profile or place lookup. Alert above 30 s.

panels.title: Disk (F9)
panels.description: Free space of the data folder as the application sees it; it refuses searches below 20 GB (FINDALINE_LIMIT_FREE_DISK_GB_MIN). The disk's alert is A3.

panels.title: Pending (F6)
panels.description: Accounts waiting for approval on the Admin page. Info: a new one.

panels.title: Reports (F8)
panels.description: Problem reports not marked done (Admin page). Info: a new one.

panels.title: Refused (F7)
panels.description: Requests refused by a rate or a quota in the last hour (audit). Alert: more than 20 and 3 times the hourly mean of the day before.

panels.title: Active (F7)
panels.description: Signed-in sessions seen within the window (15 min, 24 h).

panels.title: Area (F14)
panels.description: km² of the searches finished in the last 24 hours (in total: the panel to the right).

targets.expr: (sum(findaline_area_km2_total) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_area_km2_total offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)

panels.title: In total (F14)
panels.description: All finished searches with an area (also from before the monitoring).

panels.title: Users (F6)
panels.description: Approved accounts.

panels.title: Version (F10)
panels.description: The application's version (pyproject.toml). A new version is marked on the charts.

panels.title: Searches by status (F2)
panels.description: Waiting (queued, ready: downloaded) and running (downloading, computing); new searches are refused at queue_max.

panels.title: Running against the slots (F2)
panels.description: All slots busy and searches waiting: the worker is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Oldest waiting search (F2)
panels.description: Alert above 30 min (the dashed line).

panels.title: Worker's lease (F1)
panels.description: A heartbeat every 5 s; a lease older than 30 s (the dashed line) is dead. Alert: no worker alive for 2 min.

panels.title: Finished per hour by result (F3)
panels.description: Searches finished in the hour before each point.

panels.title: Failed per hour by error (F3)
panels.description: The error code of the failure, or its category (time_limit, worker_stopped, internal, interrupted, other). Alert on any internal one.

panels.title: Mean time per phase (F4)
panels.description: Mean of the searches finished in the 3 hours before each point: waiting in the queue, download (until computing starts, so with the wait for a compute slot), computing (stacked: the whole search).

panels.title: Mean duration by result (F4)
panels.description: From the request to the end, mean of the 3 hours before each point.

panels.title: Quick lane waiting (F5)
panels.description: Estimates, profiles and place lookups wait for the worker's one quick process. Alert: the oldest above 30 s (the dashed line).

panels.title: Quick answers per minute (F5)
panels.description: ok; no_worker (503: no worker), busy (the wait's limit), gone (the client left). Counted by the web process since its start.

panels.title: Area searched per day (F14)
panels.description: km² of the searches finished in each day (UTC) of the last 30 days, repeats included.

panels.title: Searches per day (F14)
panels.description: Finished searches with an area in each day (UTC) of the last 30 days.

panels.title: Area by country of the search (F14)
panels.description: km² in total by the country of the area's centre (unknown: before the monitoring, or no country).

panels.title: Searches by country (F14)
panels.description: Finished searches with an area in total.

panels.title: Users who searched in each country (F15, A)
panels.description: Users with a finished search in the country (one user may count in several).

panels.title: Users by country, browser's time zone (F15, B)
panels.description: Accounts by the country of their browser's time zone (unknown: not reported yet).

panels.title: Sessions (F7)
panels.description: Signed-in sessions (not visitors).

panels.title: Actions in the last hour (F7)
panels.description: Audit events in the hour before each point: sign-ins, searches added, share links, favourites, refusals, ...

panels.title: Refused in the last hour (F7)
panels.description: Requests refused by a rate limit or a quota (audit). Alert: more than 20 in an hour (the dashed line) and 3 times the hourly mean of the day before.

panels.title: Cache by folder (F9)
panels.description: Top-level folders of cache/, measured by the worker's housekeeping.

panels.title: Free disk and the 30-day forecast (F9)
panels.description: The application refuses searches below 20 GB (the dashed line).

targets.legendFormat: in 30 days at the rate of 7
